dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: It's pretty nice. Thanks for the invite.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: I just did a few laps of the place. The general layout's really quite interesting. Did you study landscape design?

choices.text: No, I just went with my gut.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Ah, so you're one of those naturally gifted types. A self-taught prodigy.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: This has piqued my interest, though... I wonder if I should study for a qualification in landscape design?

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Wow, I like the enthusiasm, haha. Thanks for the support.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: I guess I'll give it a shot, then. But could you possibly let me borrow this site before the exam, for me to practice on?

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: In return, let's see... I'll cover all your roasted Lavender Melon costs leading up to the exam. What do you think?

choices.text: I know a thing or two. You've studied it, too?
